free_tier.stated: 2 GB of cloud, 1 GB of mail and 500 MB of CryptPad, free. Extra space is sold in annual steps: 5 GB EUR 11/year, 10 GB EUR 20, 15 GB EUR 29, 30 GB EUR 56, 45 GB EUR 83, 60 GB EUR 110, with 21% VAT added for EU residents

retention.stated: Until deleted. No retention clock published

egress.terms: No published cap. The instance is donation-funded and the guidance asks users not to overuse it; that is a fair-use sentence and not a number

tooling: rclone webdav and the Nextcloud clients, which is the one real advantage: it needs no wrapper
chaining: Nothing to chain. The absolute ceiling is 60 GB at any price, so it cannot hold a share of a 10 TiB working set and cannot participate in a pool. Its role would be as a small always-available mount for a bridge's state

limits.value: extra capacity is granted by a human-reviewed application form, not by a self-serve checkout

identity_cost.detail: a Disroot account. The extra-storage form is a separate human review that asks why the space is needed

reliability_note: Donation-funded and rate-conscious. Extra storage is reviewed by hand, so capacity is a request and not a purchase. Ordering is by annual invoice with VAT added for EU residents

evidence.proved: 'If the free 2GB is not enough, you can extend your cloud storage', with WebDAV and the Nextcloud clients listed as access paths
'FREE storage: 1GB for your emails, 2GB for the cloud, 500MB for cryptpad' tiers '5GB for 11 EUR annually' up to '60GB for 110 EUR annually'; 'European users have to add a VAT of 21%'

price_per_tb_month: EUR 110/year for 60 GB, which is EUR 152/TB/year and therefore irrelevant
binding_note: The quota closes it at 60 GB, but the gate that matters more is that capacity above 2 GB is a human decision rather than a purchase, so no plan can be built on a number that arrives by review.
confidence_note: What would raise it is a re-read of the extra-storage form and a WebDAV PROPFIND against a live account.
notes: Recorded as a dead end because 60 GB is the ceiling and it cannot be raised by buying more. Its role in the corpus is as the cheapest correct WebDAV endpoint to test a client against, not as capacity.
